<b>Mossmirs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the juvenile forms of the [[Moss Mother]]s,<ref>Moss Mother [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Adult Mossmir with a fully developed stinger and hardened hide."</i></ref> capable of defending themselves with their stingers despite being soft and clumsy.<ref>Mossmir Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Small fluttering creature capable of defending itself with its small stinger. This bug is soft and clumsy, but to its fortune its home caves seem relatively free of effective predators."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Mossmirs hover aimlessly while idle. As soon as one spots [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], it flies diagonally upwards towards her. Once directly overhead, it dives straight downwards for a fixed distance, usually enough to hit the ground. After a brief pause, it flies back into the air to attempt another attack. Mossmirs can pursue Hornet over a great distance from their spawn point.

Because of their downwards attacks, it is best to hit them from the side, especially immediately after one misses its lunge. During their dive, Mossmirs can crash into water or spikes and are instantly defeated.
=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Mossmirs have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Mossmirs are found primarily in the [[Moss Grotto]], but can also be seen in the western portion of [[Weavenest Atla]] and in the Moss Grotto section of the [[Memorium]]. In [[Act 3]], two Mossmirs spawn alongside a [[Void Mass]] in Weavenest Atla.
